summary: 8,100px role page: a pale head, a video split, a grey 'what they can do' list, a teal CTA strip, an eight-item qualifications grid, four wide photo rows, a figures strip, a testimonial, a teal CTA with a portrait, a booking form and role cross-links.

sections.note: pale blurred ground with faint line icons (calculator, plus signs) and no portrait; left: serif title with two bold words, one lead line, one purple pill button. The header above has a thin purple top bar.
heading and two paragraphs left; right a pale teal card with a large play button and a caption (video)
grey band: centered serif heading and line; eight tasks in two columns, each a line icon, a purple serif title and one line
pale teal strip about 250px: one line and one purple button, centered

centered heading and paragraph; eight qualification blocks in two rows of four, each with a plus sign, a serif label and two lines (degree, experience, certification, knowledge, software, functions, excel, accuracy)
four wide rows each with a photo ground and a short text block (title and two lines) offset left or right in turn: training, data security, support, expertise
big purple figures in four columns (firms, professionals, local staff, security hours) over a wide photo strip
serif heading, one grey boxed quote with name and firm
pale teal band with a portrait right: a line, one purple button
centered heading and a line; a form (names, email, phone, company, country, consent, submit)
centered heading; four role cards (text and an Explore link) for the other roles
